description: An awareness episode of about 15 minutes for HR and recruitment staff. On an authorised exercise at Tarrowby Logistics, a fictional haulier, you first play the attacker: research the open vacancy and the recruiter, then send one job application with a CV attached. Then you swap seats and sort the recruitment inbox a message like it lands in. Only the inbox is scored, and reporting when you're unsure is always fine and never marked down.
